about:
Sovereign Newbank is a premium student accommodation located in the heart of Sheffield, thoughtfully designed to meet the diverse needs of students. With a variety of fully furnished studio and apartment options, this accommodation is ideal for both individuals and those looking to share with friends. Whether you’re studying at the University of Sheffield or Sheffield Hallam University, you’ll benefit from an unbeatable location just a short walk or tram ride from both campuses. Its blend of modern facilities, stylish interiors, and central location makes Sovereign Newbank a top choice for students looking for a high-quality, comfortable living experience in the city.
Each studio and apartment at Sovereign Newbank is designed to provide a private, self-contained living space equipped with everything you need for a convenient and relaxed student life. Rooms come fully furnished with a bed, spacious wardrobe, study desk and chair, and a private en-suite bathroom. You’ll also have a private kitchen fitted with a fridge, microwave, electric stove, and plenty of storage space for groceries and cooking essentials. A flat-screen TV and high-speed WiFi ensure you can stay entertained and connected. Best of all, all utility bills are included, making budgeting easier and helping you focus on your studies.
Sovereign Newbank also offers a fantastic selection of communal amenities designed to enhance your experience. Relax and socialize in the cinema room, catch up on group projects in the communal study areas, or unwind in the lounge spaces after a long day of lectures. The laundry room adds convenience to your weekly routine, while bike storage, CCTV security, and an on-site concierge service ensure safety and support throughout your stay.
The surrounding neighbourhood is vibrant and student-friendly, with everything you need right on your doorstep. You’ll find several supermarkets nearby. Food lovers will enjoy a wide variety of restaurants and cafes and for medical needs, places like Duke Medical Centre and Medicspot Clinic are close by.
Getting around Sheffield is easy thanks to excellent transport links. The nearest bus station (First South Yorkshire) is just a minute away, and the Cathedral tram stop is only a 5-minute walk, connecting you to the rest of the city. If you prefer walking, Sheffield Train Station is about a 10-minute walk from the property, making regional travel simple and accessible. Students commuting to classes or heading out to explore the city will find the location ideal for convenience and connectivity.
When it comes to choosing your room, Sovereign Newbank offers a range of layouts to suit different lifestyles and budgets. Whether you prefer a classic, deluxe, or premium studio, each provides a cosy and private space. For those who want more room or are planning to live with a friend, the two-bedroom and superior apartments are perfect for shared living while still offering privacy and comfort.
Sovereign Newbank Sheffield combines style, practicality, and location into one exceptional student accommodation. With high-spec rooms, top-tier facilities, and a buzzing neighbourhood full of food, entertainment, and culture, it’s the perfect place to make the most of your student years in Sheffield.
